description: This file is a shell script that manages LED status indicators, including functions to identify the appropriate status LED and set its state based on system phases like preinit, failsafe, and done.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and sets the status LED file based on color and power status.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state depending on the argument indicating system initialization phase.
